system.description: Use this Skill to deconstruct explosive bombs and smoke bombs. You can then use the half-sized bomb, or use the component parts to craft new bombs using other Skills. If you are using a Sapper's Table, you do not have to make an Unopposed Explosives Handling Skill Check to avoid a mishap. Time required is 1 hour. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you have deconstructed it.

upgrades.description: You never have to make an Explosives Handling Skill Check when using this skill.
When cutting dynamite in half to make smaller bombs, round dice up. Time required is 15 minutes.
